proof_steps: For one capped-difference scalar, H_2(P,Q)=sum_y max(P(y)-2Q(y),0)=2^(-(K+1)) for a unit shift, in both directions
A neighboring histogram differs in exactly one coordinate j. Independence gives P(y)=p_j(y_j) r(y_-j) and Q(y)=q_j(y_j) r(y_-j)
Since r>=0 and sums to one, joint H_2 equals scalar H_2, independent of B
Coordinatewise clipping to public [0,N] is deterministic postprocessing and cannot increase H_2
